The operator records whether access was obtained, which control failed, and how the owner can remediate it. An append-only audit record includes target, authorization reference, timestamp, check identifier, outcome, evidence hash, and operator identity.

A reporting layer groups findings by severity and recommends patching, MFA, segmentation, least privilege, or removal of obsolete services. Safeguards include dry-run mode, a kill switch, concurrency limits, a stop at the end of the approved window, and tests for malformed manifests, out-of-scope targets, rate-limit violations, secret redaction, and cancellation.
